completion_audits.required_scope: Separate FAILED, EXPIRED and REFUNDED orders with same Cart idempotency key as their checkout. User, Creator/Admin and Guest local collections. Retry session/order read shows terminal error, retains Cart and does not create successful access.
proof: Twelve signed buyer/outcome browser journeys: actual201session/200order, expected terminal status, failure message, busy state clears and Cart survives reload. Guest login gate/synthetic USER collection handoff verified separately for every outcome.
FAILED uses four real prior pending orders and actual development fake-event API. No new grants or orders from retries.

EXPIRED uses four actual pending orders from normal browser checkout. Only their expiry timestamps are aged in isolated PostgreSQL; statuses remain PENDING until actual checkout expiration processing changes them to EXPIRED. No clock patch or synthetic HTTP status.

REFUNDED uses four separate actual pending orders. Actual fake PAID event inserts four ACTIVE PURCHASE grants; actual fake full refunds mark those same four REVOKED. Browser retries, including one additional reload retry, preserve revocation.
Eight old paid orders/91 old active grants and27 Courses remain unchanged. Final20 orders:8 PAID/4 FAILED/4 EXPIRED/4 REFUNDED;95 total grants:91ACTIVE/4REVOKED.
Actual key hashes match initial Pending checkout for expiry/refund pools; actual returned order IDs match each buyer/outcome pool. No raw keys/JWT recorded.
scope_limits: Synthetic role/session setup is not normal login or registration.
Past expiry is a controlled fixture prerequisite, not a real30-minute elapsed-time test.
Fake payment/refund API is isolated test profile only; no real payment provider or cloud writes.

completion_audits.required_scope: Fake auto-success paid checkout; User, Guest local collection and Creator/Admin Cart variants. Only PAID clears paid Cart and opens Library; all purchased Products have server entitlements.
proof: Actual auto-success bulk20 checkouts persist one PAID order/20 ACTIVE PURCHASE grants per buyer, clear Cart and reach Library for User/Admin and Guest synthetic User. All20 cards survive reload.
Creator receives valid PAID order/20 persisted grants and cleared Cart but success destination becomes unauthorized Library: existing BUG-049 contradicts the required destination.

Actual PENDING and all three terminal states are now verified across roles and Guest collection handoff. Their paid Cart remains; pending/failed/expired produce no access, refunded access stays revoked.
Test payment provider is fake; these observations make no real-charge/provider-support claim.

from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,urllib.request,subprocess,datetime,uuid
root=Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-browser-cartstates');poolpath=Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-terminal-order-pools.json');setup=Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-terminal-setup-observations.json')
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
pools=read(poolpath) if poolpath.exists() else {};actions=read(setup) if setup.exists() else []
mode=sys.argv[1];phase=sys.argv[2]
assert phase in ['failed','expired','refunded']

sources.content:
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request,json,sys,datetime
f=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-browser-cartstates-private-session.json').read_text());assert sys.argv[1] in ['rename','restore'];pid=f['products']['freePartialA'];original='Synthetic cart freePartialA';renamed='Synthetic cart freePartialA renamed for placeholder check';target=renamed if sys.argv[1]=='rename' else original;expected=original if sys.argv[1]=='rename' else renamed
headers={'Cookie':'JWT_TOKEN='+f['subjects']['OWNER']['jwt']+'; XSRF-TOKEN='+f['csrf'],'X-XSRF-TOKEN':f['csrf'],'Content-Type':'application/json'}
url='http://127.0.0.1:'+str(f['port'])+'/api/products/'+pid
with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,headers=headers)) as q:before=json.load(q)
assert before['id']==pid and before['name']==expected
with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps({'name':target}).encode(),headers=headers,method='PATCH')) as q:after=json.load(q);status=q.status
assert status==200 and after['name']==target and after['status']=='PUBLISHED'
p=Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-placeholder-product-actions.json');a=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else [];a.append({'observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'action':sys.argv[1],'method':'PATCH','path':'/api/products/'+pid,'status':status,'before':{k:before.get(k) for k in ['id','name','status','price']},'after':{k:after.get(k) for k in ['id','name','status','price']}});p.write_text(json.dumps(a,indent=2)+'\n');print(a[-1])

assessed: Every listed journey stage executed through normal full-App UI using actual loopback backend and migrated PostgreSQL. New Course authored and Published in uninterrupted fresh creation session; no API publication substitution.
Landing copy/About saved and full reload verified; explicit featured Course saved in normal Storefront builder; Guest observes Published Course and excludes retained Draft fixture.

Guest enrollment redirects to login. Separate existing synthetic USER session setup is a fixture handoff, not a tested credential login. User normal enrollment201 creates exactly one ACTIVE FREE_ENROLLMENT grant; no commerce order.
Library reload and normal matching-card Open reach the Course reader. Authored Tiptap Article renders literal JSON before/after reader reload, extending BUG-021 to a separate entitled learner.
Creator Customers list/detail/reload/Purchases/Access show Buyer, one active product, free source, no membership, €0 spent, zero orders and no purchase history.

Actual paired API reads support Guest/unentitled User/second Creator redaction and owner/Admin access boundaries; only enrolled User gains body access. These supporting API checks do not imply separate browser journeys for every actor. No local completion/progress assertion is invented.

assessed: Guest Contact/brand/Products links set correct hashes and target rectangles enter the viewport.
Featured link and matching catalogue button each navigate canonical /app/product/UUID and render the correct Published Course.
Normal empty Cart verified before/after; actual proxy window contains no non-auth mutations. Actual orders unchanged. Existing Creator-role observations retained.
STORE-018.outcome: Fully assessed Pass for listed Guest presentation steps.

assessed: Shared journey evidence now confirms the existing Tiptap-to-HTML rendering conflict for a separately entitled User and full reader reload; Guest remains redacted.
remaining: HTML fixture and inert unsafe-markup sanitizer checks across required public roles remain.
DISC-021.outcome: Partial; this journey does not cover the remaining sanitizer matrix.

cleanup_state: Actual local frontend (session 65237, port 4329), backend (session 88404, port 61339) and isolated PostgreSQL (port 51980) retained. Existing data preserved; the new Published free Course and one FREE_ENROLLMENT grant remain. Totals: 98 grants and 35 orders. The interrupted October 10 Course remains Draft. Local Cart is empty. The real signed-in Creator Dashboard was verified on October 12; cloud data was untouched, and the observer logs/tunnel were not revalidated.
runtime_recovery: Previous handles41349/87058 missing and ports4329/58398 absent before restart. PostgreSQL51980 verified live. Missing temporary MigratedCascadeQa helper restored byte-identical from evidence SHA b3a747b2869f0f700ad8354404f7b321ce489a268b3dd4fbf8cbb592b83859d3. No reseeding or app source edits. Routine refresh preserved existing subjects/roles/normal token lifetime.
interruption_scope: Draft October10 Course persisted; its unsubmitted lesson form was not scored. Fresh October12 creation uses a distinct Product. Two automatic review429 failures did not execute actions; normal reviewed retries succeeded. Two locator errors were corrected from current DOM and not scored as app bugs.
visible_reader_followup_note: The same original authored JSON lesson was explicitly opened as the entitled User during the subsequent Article matrix, confirming the visible JSON defect. Earlier normal Library Open/read snapshots alone included a collapsed section; the opened follow-up is the direct visibility evidence.

DISC-021.required_scope: Guest and User/Creator/Admin public Course discovery; authorized HTML/editor JSON reading; inert unsafe markup sanitization.
assessed: Normal unchanged browser reader explicitly opened the Course section initially and after reload as entitled User, owner Creator and Admin. Safe HTML preserves bold/list/allowed link. Inert application/json script, onclick attributes and javascript:void(0) href are removed while safe bold/text/allowed href remain. No unsafe link was followed or script/event executed.
Guest public outline exposes all three lesson titles but no private bodies, before/after reload; paired actual API reads prove content is redacted for Guest and unchanged for authorized roles.
Editor JSON remains literal for all authorized browser roles. Existing owner/User failures retained; new Admin failure extends BUG-021.
Only the specific catalog inert fixtures were assessed; no claim of exhaustive XSS protection or deployed parity.

Supplemental visual reader check fails: actual opened User lesson text is rgb(248,249,250) against a white legacy expansion panel. Existing light-panel foreground/background issue BUG-027 extended to Course reader; semantic formatting/sanitizer passes do not imply legibility.
DISC-021.outcome: Fully assessed Fail because of existing editor JSON rendering conflict.

assessed: Fresh normal Creator workspace authors bold text/list; actual autosave GET retains Tiptap JSON with bulletList and bold mark.
Normal close/reopen displays starter paragraph while actual persisted body remains unchanged, reproducing BUG-018 without a destructive follow-up edit.
Authorized existing Admin PATCH repeats the same saved bold/list JSON; owner GET retains it.
Normal Publish and separate User enrollment allow public reader verification; User explicitly opens the Course section before/after reload and sees saved bold/list JSON literally, BUG-021.
remaining: Creator normal Link button calls prompt(), which the built-in browser rejects. No link was entered. Required link authoring/round-trip remains blocked until a browser supporting prompts is available. API/HTML link fixtures do not replace this browser step.
CONTENT-012.outcome: Partial with specific link-input browser blocker; no new application issue for browser prompt support.

cleanup_state: Actual local frontend session 65237/port 4329, backend session 88404/port 61339 and private PostgreSQL port 51980 retained. Existing Course now has its original JSON Article plus two HTML probe Articles. A separate normally authored Published round-trip Course and one additional FREE_ENROLLMENT grant remain. Totals:99 grants and35 unchanged orders. No real account or cloud data changed. Link prompt remains unavailable in the built-in browser.
visible_reader_confirmation: Screenshot review found that initial DOM captures came from a collapsed section. Every authorized role then explicitly opened the section initially and after reload; expanded-state snapshots and six new DOM captures prove the same formatting, sanitizer and JSON outcomes in the actual visible reader. The separate round-trip User reader was also opened before/after reload. These are supporting checks within the same variations, not additional assessed variations.

required_steps: Existing PAID entitlement and featured Product
assessed: Existing ACTIVE PURCHASE grant linked through its item to the exact buyer PAID order verified in actual database. Existing Article reused; no payment/grant/content was fabricated. Synthetic owner API configures featured Product; normal Guest discovery and purchased User Library/Open/expanded Article pass before hiding.
Supported owner PATCH hides Product. Actual storefront responses across roles remove it and null featured ID; normal Guest storefront omits it and Guest direct Product403 renders unavailable.

Buyer Library retains Hidden purchase entry; actual Product GET200 includes protected Article and access endpoint remains true. Second Creator fixture also has an existing purchase grant and is correctly treated as an entitled caller, not an unrelated denial control.

Normal purchased User Library Open and reload render Product unavailable because public browser guard rejects Hidden, despite retained protected API access. Intentional behavior versus paid-learning policy remains a clarification, not an invented new bug.

Supported restoration returns original Published state/content/metadata and original feature/order/theme semantics. Normal buyer expanded reader/Library recover using same grant. No refund or financial/grant change.
JOURNEY-003.outcome: Fully assessed Needs clarification: should paid buyers retain browser learning when a seller hides a Product from public sales? Catalog explicitly retains this conflict for investigation.

DISC-015.required_scope: Public Product routes for Draft/Hidden across Guest, User, Creator owner and Admin; entitled User and owner/Admin protected API controls; separate management preview.
assessed: Actual owner API sets existing disposable granted Course to Hidden then Draft; all four normal browser roles deny public route initially and after reload, with zero private lesson DOM nodes.
Guest API403 while entitled User/owner/Admin GET200 retain all three private bodies and access remains true. Browser status guard independently rejects both states.
Owner/Admin normal private management preview renders Hidden/Draft marketing presentation and outline; it is not a protected learner reader or public availability.
Course restored to Published with content/metadata unchanged; normal entitled User opened reader and owner Overview recover. Existing deployed Draft Course/Download/Membership evidence retained.
DISC-015.outcome: Fully assessed Pass for the specified lifecycle/role guard; no claim of equal content behavior across all Product types.

from pathlib import Path
import json,urllib.request,urllib.error,sys,datetime,subprocess
f=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-browser-cartstates-private-session.json').read_text());pid='7b77d685-ab7c-448e-97db-7db93b6912df';owner=f['subjects']['OWNER']['id'];mode=sys.argv[1];assert mode in ['prepare','hide','restore']
p=Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-hide-after-purchase-oct12.json');x=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {'product_id':pid,'owner_id':owner,'http':[],'db':[]}
def save():p.write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n')
def call(role,method,path,body=None,status=None):
 h={} if role=='GUEST' else {'Cookie':'JWT_TOKEN='+f['subjects'][role]['jwt']+'; XSRF-TOKEN='+f['csrf'],'X-XSRF-TOKEN':f['csrf'],'Content-Type':'application/json'}
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(f['port'])+path,data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None,headers=h,method=method),timeout=15) as q:code=q.status;raw=q.read()
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as q:code=q.code;raw=q.read()
 data=json.loads(raw) if raw else None
 if status is not None:assert code==status,(role,path,code,data)
 x['http'].append({'phase':mode,'observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'actor':role,'method':method,'path':path,'requested':body,'status':code,'body':data});save();return data

sources.content:
from pathlib import Path
import json,urllib.request,urllib.error,urllib.parse,sys,datetime,subprocess
f=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-browser-cartstates-private-session.json').read_text());uid=f['subjects']['CREATOR']['id'];phase=sys.argv[1];expected=sys.argv[2];assert expected in ['USER','CREATOR','ADMIN']
p=Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-role-journey-oct12.json');x=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else {'target_id':uid,'phases':[]};obs=[]
def get(role,path,profile=False):
 h={} if role=='GUEST' else {'Cookie':'JWT_TOKEN='+f['subjects'][role]['jwt']}
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(f['port'])+path,headers=h),timeout=15) as q:status=q.status;raw=q.read()
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as q:status=q.code;raw=q.read()
 body=json.loads(raw) if raw else None
 if profile and isinstance(body,dict):body={k:v for k,v in body.items() if k in ['userId','id','firstName','lastName','roles','role','email','onboardingCompleted','onboardingcompleted','enabled','authProvider','displayName','title','tagline','bio','publicEmail']}
 obs.append({'actor':role,'method':'GET','path':path,'status':status,'body':body});return status,body
get('CREATOR','/api/user/userInfo',True)
status,page=get('ADMIN','/api/admin/users?search='+urllib.parse.quote('cartstates-creator@example.invalid'));assert status==200;target=next(u for u in page['content'] if u['id']==uid);assert target['roles']==[expected],target
get('ADMIN','/api/admin/audit?targetId='+uid+'&action=ROLE_CHANGE')
get('GUEST','/api/storefronts/'+uid)
get('CREATOR','/api/creator/storefront')
c=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-pg-cartstates-runtime.json').read_text());base=Path(c['path']);assert str(base).startswith('/private/tmp/vpqa-pg-cartstates-') and c['database']=='vpqa_cascades'
sql="SELECT json_build_object('admin_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE r.role_name='ADMIN'),'roles',(SELECT json_agg(r.role_name ORDER BY r.role_name) FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id='"+uid+"'),'products',(SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT id,user_id,name,price,status FROM course_products WHERE user_id='"+uid+"' UNION ALL SELECT id,user_id,name,price,status FROM download_products WHERE user_id='"+uid+"' UNION ALL SELECT id,user_id,name,price,status FROM consultation_products WHERE user_id='"+uid+"' UNION ALL SELECT id,user_id,name,price,status FROM membership_products WHERE user_id='"+uid+"' ORDER BY id) t),'grants',(SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT id,user_id,product_id,status,source FROM product_entitlements ORDER BY id) t),'orders',(SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT id,buyer_user_id,status,total_minor FROM commerce_orders ORDER BY id) t));"
r=subprocess.run(['/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@15/bin/psql','-h',str(base/'socket'),'-p',str(c['port']),'-U',c['user'],'-d',c['database'],'-At','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-c',sql],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr;db=json.loads(r.stdout);assert db['roles']==[expected]
if x['phases']:
 original=x['phases'][0]['database'];assert db['products']==original['products'] and db['grants']==original['grants'] and db['orders']==original['orders']
meta=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-session-refresh-metadata.json').read_text());x['phases'].append({'phase':phase,'observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'expected_role':expected,'issued_role_metadata':meta,'http':obs,'database':db});p.write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n');print({'phase':phase,'role':expected,'products':len(db['products']),'grants':len(db['grants']),'orders':len(db['orders']),'statuses':[(o['actor'],o['path'],o['status']) for o in obs]})

assessed: Actual Creator/Admin API patches persist negative, zero and maximum signed integer values for buffers and daily capacity on Published metadata fixtures. No scheduling/capacity enforcement or booking is claimed. Numeric business limits need clarification.

from pathlib import Path
import json,urllib.request,datetime,subprocess
p=Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-admin-state-readback-oct13.json');assert not p.exists();f=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-browser-cartstates-private-session.json').read_text());folder=Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-independent-role-ui-oct12');assert json.loads((folder/'admin-faults.json').read_text())=={}
obs=json.loads((folder/'observations.json').read_text());selected=[o for o in obs if o['key'].startswith('admin-state-') and o['key'].endswith('oct13')];lo=min(o['observed_at'] for o in selected);logs=json.loads((folder/'service-observations.json').read_text())['observations'];logs=[o for o in logs if o['observed_at']>='2026-10-13T07:44:42' and (o.get('path','').startswith('/api/admin/') or o.get('kind','').startswith('controlled-admin-'))];http=[]
paths=list(dict.fromkeys(o['path'] for o in logs if o.get('method')=='GET' and o.get('status')==200))
for path in paths:
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(f['port'])+path,headers={'Cookie':'JWT_TOKEN='+f['subjects']['ADMIN']['jwt']}),timeout=15) as q:http.append({'path':path,'status':q.status,'body':json.loads(q.read()),'observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()})
assert all(r['body']['totalElements']==0 for r in http if 'No+such+synthetic+QA+October13' in r['path'] or r['path'].endswith('146526f8a2c8x'))
role_errors=[o for o in logs if o.get('method')=='PATCH'];assert len(role_errors)==1 and role_errors[0]['status']==503 and role_errors[0]['kind']=='controlled-admin-error' and not role_errors[0]['actual_backend_called']
c=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-pg-cartstates-runtime.json').read_text());base=Path(c['path']);assert str(base).startswith('/private/tmp/vpqa-pg-cartstates-') and c['database']=='vpqa_cascades'
q="SELECT json_build_object('products',(SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT id,user_id,name,status,price,'COURSE' as type FROM course_products UNION ALL SELECT id,user_id,name,status,price,'DOWNLOAD' FROM download_products UNION ALL SELECT id,user_id,name,status,price,'CONSULTATION' FROM consultation_products UNION ALL SELECT id,user_id,name,status,price,'MEMBERSHIP' FROM membership_products ORDER BY id) t));"
r=subprocess.run(['/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@15/bin/psql','-h',str(base/'socket'),'-p',str(c['port']),'-U',c['user'],'-d',c['database'],'-At','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-c',q],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr;db=json.loads(r.stdout);assert len(db['products'])==40
old=json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-admin-delete-oct12.json').read_text())['readbacks'][-1]['database']['products'];after={v['id']:v for v in db['products']};assert all(after[v['id']]==v for v in old);new={v['id'] for v in db['products']}-{v['id'] for v in old};expected={v['id'] for v in json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-consultation-boundaries-oct12.json').read_text())['fixtures']};assert new==expected
p.write_text(json.dumps({'recorded_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'http':http,'proxy_window':logs,'fault_controls':json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-admin-fault-controls-oct13.json').read_text()),'database':db,'final_faults':{},'role_mutation_backend_called':False},indent=2)+'\n');print({'actual_api_readbacks':len(http),'controlled_role_mutations':1,'actual_role_mutations':0,'products':40,'original_product_records_unchanged':True,'faults_restored':True})

from pathlib import Path
import json,urllib.request,datetime,sys,subprocess
phase=sys.argv[1];r=Path('/private/tmp');f=json.loads((r/'vpqa-browser-cartstates-private-session.json').read_text());c=json.loads((r/'vpqa-pg-cartstates-runtime.json').read_text());pid='efc109c1-e344-40b9-8931-89f6fa8e0d0b';p=r/'vpqa-membership-readback-oct13.json';x=json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else [];h={'Cookie':'JWT_TOKEN='+f['subjects']['CREATOR']['jwt']+'; XSRF-TOKEN='+f['csrf'],'X-XSRF-TOKEN':f['csrf']};b={}
for path in ['/api/products/'+pid,'/api/products/'+pid+'/membership']:
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(f['port'])+path,headers=h),timeout=15) as q:assert q.status==200;b[path]=json.loads(q.read())
assert b['/api/products/'+pid]['userId']==f['subjects']['CREATOR']['id'];query="SELECT json_build_object('product',(SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM (SELECT id,user_id,name,status FROM membership_products WHERE id='%s') t),'users',(SELECT count(*) FROM users),'products',((SELECT count(*) FROM course_products)+(SELECT count(*) FROM download_products)+(SELECT count(*) FROM consultation_products)+(SELECT count(*) FROM membership_products)),'grants',(SELECT count(*) FROM product_entitlements),'orders',(SELECT count(*) FROM commerce_orders),'audit',(SELECT count(*) FROM admin_audit_logs));"%pid
q=subprocess.run(['/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@15/bin/psql','-h',str(Path(c['path'])/'socket'),'-p',str(c['port']),'-U',c['user'],'-d',c['database'],'-At','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-c',query],capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0,q.stderr;db=json.loads(q.stdout);assert db['grants']==105 and db['orders']==42 and db['products']==44;x.append({'phase':phase,'observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'actual_api':b,'db':db});p.write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n');agg=b['/api/products/'+pid+'/membership'];print({'phase':phase,'aggregate_keys':list(agg),'content_count':len(agg.get('content',[])),'counts':{k:v for k,v in db.items() if k!='product'}})

lessons.content: Disposable checkout limit fixture.

assessed: Normal Creator Product save responses were dropped after actual upstream200. Actual API/SQL and normal Overview reload show committed name. Back flush retries the identical request hash and succeeds200. Two same-payload requests lost responses before the manual retry; no duplicate Product.

Normal Storefront Light appearance save commits200, then response is dropped. Original tab shows Network Error/unsaved; separate fresh browser reload and API prove Light persisted. Same normal Save retry has identical payload hash and succeeds200.

Controlled single paid cart fixture uses a real Published, unowned Course and current1EUR price; normal fake checkout creates one PENDING100minor order, then its201response is dropped. SQL and authorized actual orderGET200 prove persistence; no new access grant.
remaining: Restore a usable isolated database/runtime and execute a fresh response-loss checkout followed promptly by normal same-key retry and post-retry order/API/database verification. The original43-order cluster is missing PG_VERSION/config and the session/order retry window has elapsed.
Original local Product/Storefront values were not restored before runtime loss; preserve that limitation in the historical evidence.
JOURNEY-007.outcome: Partial: Product and Storefront commit/retry journeys pass; committed fake order verified, same-key retry remains unexecuted.

cleanup_state: Runtime stopped by14October; old local data directory lacks PG_VERSION/postgresql.conf, no intact cluster/backup found. No reseed or unsafe recovery. Historical snapshots show129Users/44Products/105grants/43orders/35audits, one newPending fakeorder dd65de4d. Shared name/Storefront Light persisted and were not restored before interruption. These are last observed counts, not current live-state claims. Expired synthetic sessions not reused. No deployed mutation in this local journey.
scope_notes: Pre-response socket is closed only after reading actual successful upstream response; this differs from pre-backend failure.
Initial chosen paidCourse was already owned. Read-only baseline identified unowned Course01; no invalid ownership checkout was attempted.

Normal Product page displays Price unavailable; that presentation is outside this network-boundary assessment. Checkout fixture is the already existing explicit cart initializer with actual ProductID/currentprice and newclientkey; normal Product-to-cart metadata flow is not claimed.
Checkout feedback toast was not captured after an incorrect text waiter. Cart/button recovery and order persistence are observed; no visible toast assertion is claimed.
Order readback succeeded; diagnostic print assumed id instead of orderId and failed only after evidence was saved. No checkout retry was executed.
